description: This file defines OpenGL 1.5 entry point functions, including buffer and query management, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: BeginQuery
methods.description: Starts a query object for a specified target and ID, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: BindBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a target, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: BufferData
methods.description: Creates and initializes buffer data store, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: BufferSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data store, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: DeleteBuffers
methods.description: Deletes buffer objects, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: DeleteQueries
methods.description: Deletes query objects, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: EndQuery
methods.description: Ends a query for a specified target, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GenBuffers
methods.description: Generates buffer object names, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GenQueries
methods.description: Generates query object names, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GetBufferParameteriv
methods.description: Retrieves parameters of a buffer object, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GetBufferPointerv
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to buffer data, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GetBufferSubData
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of buffer data, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GetQueryObjectiv
methods.description: Retrieves a query object parameter as an integer, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GetQueryObjectuiv
methods.description: Retrieves a query object parameter as an unsigned integer, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: GetQueryiv
methods.description: Retrieves query target parameters, with validation and context handling.

methods.name: IsBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a name corresponds to a buffer object, with validation.

methods.name: IsQuery
methods.description: Checks if a name corresponds to a query object, with validation.

methods.name: MapBuffer
methods.description: Maps a buffer object's data store to client address space, with validation.

methods.name: UnmapBuffer
methods.description: Unmaps a buffer object's data store, with validation.
